stages.title: CENTRAL ASIAN POLITICAL FIELD

pills.text: RIVAL PRINCES COMPETE FOR SAMARQAND/HERAT PRESTIGE
CONSOLIDATE TRANSOXIANA AND DEFEAT SCATTERED CLAIMANTS
TEMPORARY OPENING AFTER MERV PLUS KHUTBA/SIKKA CONDITIONS

sequence: TIMURID FRAGMENTATION → rival princes compete for Samarqand/Herat prestige
SHAYBANI UZBEKS → consolidate Transoxiana and defeat scattered claimants
SAFAVID IRAN → temporary opening after Merv plus khutba/sikka conditions
OTTOMAN CHALDIRAN → changes regional balance, not a direct India switch
BABUR → Farghana loss + Samarqand cycles → Kabul 1504
